title: Reinstatement and Redemption After Repossession — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
After repossession and until the sale, the customer under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract may get the vehicle back either by reinstating the contract or by redeeming the vehicle.

## Reinstatement

- **Window.** A reinstatement must be completed no later than the tier's company reinstatement window after the vehicle was repossessed and before the scheduled sale date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the repossession date and completion on the last day is timely; where the contract records a state reinstatement period longer than the company window, that longer period is used in place of the company window in the same count.
- **Count.** The contract must show reinstatements used below the tier's maximum, unless the contract records a state reinstatement period greater than 0.
- **Relationship.** The company does not offer a discretionary reinstatement while another Kestrel contract or lease of the customer shows days past due of the tier's relationship limit or more; a reinstatement the contract's recorded state reinstatement period grants is still offered.
- **Amount.** The reinstatement amount is the past-due amount plus the fees due balance, which includes late charges and every repossession expense booked; storage is billed up to the reinstatement date before the amount is stated.
- **Effect.** Once the funds post the vehicle is released and the original schedule resumes with the next due date set to the next installment.

## Redemption

The redemption amount is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus accrued interest for the quote interest days at the per diem, the per diem being the principal balance times the APR divided by 100 divided by the day basis, rounded to the cent; the quote interest days run from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the redemption payment date, both inclusive. Redemption is available at any time before the sale regardless of prior reinstatements. Once the funds post the vehicle is released.

## Funds

Reinstatement and redemption funds are accepted only as cashier's check, wire or MoneyGram.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, 15-day company window, sale scheduled later)

| Repossessed | State period recorded | Last timely day |
|---|---|---|
| The 1st of a month | 0 | The 16th |
| The 1st of a month | 20 days | The 21st |

Completion on the day after the last timely day, or on or after the scheduled sale date, is outside the window.
